column2: 🚚️move is the move domain of the semio repository tooling: the sealed evidence guard and the folder and file tools.
🧩️section carries the section and definition tool functions of the move domain.
🧵️integrate carries the integrate and extract tools of the move domain with the header split and merge helpers.
🔤️rename carries the rename tool of the move domain with the casing helpers and the file and directory copy helpers.
